failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Who were the actresses in "Hootenanny Hoot" (1963) film? Did Linda Evans appear in "Hootenanny Hoot"? What actresses co-starred with Linda Evans in "Hootenanny Hoot" and what were their nationalities?' — Compound multi-part query bundling several targets (actresses list, Linda Evans presence, co-stars, nationalities) in natural-language question format.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 query: 'Did Linda Evans appear in the 1963 film "Hootenanny Hoot"? If so, who were her co-stars, and was any of them Canadian? Alternatively, what is the complete cast list of "Hootenanny Hoot" (1963) and the nationalities of all cast members?' — Natural-language yes/no question followed by conditional multi-part asks bundling co-stars and nationality verification.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Both hop 2 and hop 3 queries re-ask substantially the same questions about Linda Evans's presence in Hootenanny Hoot, the co-stars, and their nationalities. Hop 2: 'Did Linda Evans appear in "Hootenanny Hoot"? What actresses co-starred with Linda Evans...' Hop 3: 'Did Linda Evans appear in the 1963 film "Hootenanny Hoot"? If so, who were her co-stars...' Despite hop 2 returning information that the film stars Peter Breck and Ruta Lee with no mention of Linda Evans, hop 3 repeats the same inquiry without substantively advancing the search strategy.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1 explicitly names the missing entity: 'the passages lack... Information about the cast of "Hootenanny Hoot" - there is no confirmation that Linda Evans appeared in this film [and] Identification of any actress who co-starred with Linda Evans in "Hootenanny Hoot"'. Hop 2 query targets this: 'Did Linda Evans appear in "Hootenanny Hoot"? If so, who were her co-stars, and was any of them Canadian?' and hop 3 repeats it. Despite well-formed targeting (albeit in poor query shape per B.13), retrieval returns only the same passage stating the film stars Peter Breck and Ruta Lee, never delivering information about Linda Evans's presence or her co-stars.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 retrieval returns multiple irrelevant passages about unrelated topics: 'List of Star Wars cast members', 'List of Judy Garland performances', 'List of Dallas (1978 TV series) cast members', 'General Hospital cast members', and 'List of previous General Hospital cast members'. These passages about TV series cast lists from 1978-1991 and film franchises have no connection to the 1963 film Hootenanny Hoot or Linda Evans. The agent receives and must process these entirely tangential documents.
